_comment: Rate card. Prices are in whole dollars, before tax, and are given per season: high season is the peak summer band, low season the shoulders either side. A null price means that combination has not been confirmed yet — the server will refuse to sell those dates for that site type and the website will say to call, rather than quoting a number nobody entered. Figures below were taken from the campground's published rates; confirm them against the office before taking live payments, and fill in what is still null.
